metrics.investment_case_interpretation: After excluding client segregated cash and paired financial-product assets, the conservative discounted detachable net cash still exceeds the rough market cap by about HKD 304m. The company enters profit_cheap because market cap divided by discounted sustainable distributable cash profit is about 10.3 years, but this is low-confidence for a financial services business with volatile underwriting, loan impairment and regulatory liquidity needs.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank balances and cash - general accounts
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Hong Kong listed financial services group cash, but annual report does not split holding company cash from regulated subsidiaries or prove immediate dividend capacity; use financial-business conservative haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Only general-account cash is considered potentially detachable before retaining operating/regulatory liquidity.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged to bank as security for facilities; not treated as freely detachable despite no bank borrowings at year end.
cash_breakdown.reason: Restricted by pledge and therefore excluded from detachable pool.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank balances and cash - segregated accounts
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Client and other institution money held in segregated bank accounts for regulated activities, with corresponding accounts payable.
cash_breakdown.reason: Customer/regulatory funds cannot be used by a controller as detachable corporate cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Assets acquired for financial products issued
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unlisted equity investments are paired hedge assets for financial products issued at the same fair value; net exposure is not significant.
cash_breakdown.reason: Excluded from detachable cash to avoid treating matched product assets as surplus cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial products issued at fair value
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Paired liability against the above financial product assets; shown for trace, but main net cash excludes both sides on a matched basis.
cash_breakdown.reason: Structured financial product liability offsets its underlying asset.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states no bank borrowings at 30 September 2025.
Ordinary operating lease burden for offices and operations; reflected in profit/cash quality rather than mechanically deducted from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not treated as acquisition financing debt in the main net cash formula.

cash_breakdown.item: Necessary operating and regulatory liquidity reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Estimated reserve for regulated securities, futures, wealth/asset management and financing operations where exact liquid capital and subsidiary cash distribution capacity are not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Retained to avoid impairing ordinary operations and licensed business liquidity.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Conservative friction reserve because cash location and distributability by legal entity are not fully disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Controller extraction would face execution and regulatory friction.

profit_quality.assessment: Usable but low-confidence cash-profit denominator. 2025 profit improved to HKD 146.936m, but the five-year summary shows losses in 2021-2023 and only two recent profitable years. 2025 operating cash flow is not a clean free-cash-flow proxy because it includes loan book runoff, segregated account cash and client payable movements.
adjustments: Excluded HKD 53.182m bank deposit interest from the sustainable cash-profit base because the general cash balance is treated as part of detachable net cash.
Did not capitalize the HKD 1.002bn reported operating cash flow as distributable cash because regulated client balances and loan-book movements are embedded in operating activities.
Added back the non-cash share-based payment conceptually, but retained a conservative pre-haircut cash profit of HKD 80m rather than using the full 2025 net profit.
Applied a 0.50 profit haircut for financial services cyclicality, volatile underwriting economics, impairment swings and limited multi-year cash-profit evidence.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 CFO was HKD 1.002bn, but included HKD 585.092m decrease in loans and advances, HKD 356.213m increase in segregated-account cash, HKD 344.502m increase in accounts payable and HKD 234.688m interest received.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent profits are positive but not yet proven through a full cycle; financial business cash flow and loan impairment volatility require a large haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported CFO is positive but not directly distributable because of regulated client-money and loan-book mechanics.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Capex was small at HKD 0.387m in 2025; this is not the binding constraint.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital movements are dominated by financial receivables, loans, segregated accounts and client payables, so best-year CFO is not used to set the profit denominator.

limitations: Financial services company: ordinary industrial-company cash extraction formula is only partially applicable.
General-account cash is not split by legal entity, regulated subsidiary or immediately distributable holding-company cash.
Required operating/regulatory liquidity is estimated, not disclosed.
Sustainable profit is based on conservative analytical judgement because 2021-2023 were loss-making and only 2024-2025 detailed annual facts were extracted.
Market cap comes from rough_screen_row and was not independently refreshed in this run.
